name: Kentucky Wesleyan College
tuition_note: 2026-27 full-time annual tuition & fees ($35,545) from kwc.edu/admissions/cost-and-aid/tuition-and-fees/; private college with a single published rate. Room is not published separately from dining, so housing_cost is the lowest standard room+dining option (Peeples/Deacon Double & Dining, $11,465); other options range up to $16,740.
